proves.claim: the live cells edge report has no packageApps row for the native flake source.

flakes.app-edges.live-report-no-row.why: The package-to-app ceiling row was removed by #6452 and must not return.

proves.claim: the committed cells-edges.json ceiling has no packageApps row for those files.

flakes.app-edges.committed-ceiling-no-ro.why: A stale committed row would let the dependency back in unnoticed.

proves.claim: tier 1 judges reachable failures, static or check failures and unreachable failures apart.

flakes.verdict.tier1-judges-apart.why: The shadow verdict must classify each failure kind the way the real verdict does.

proves.claim: a malformed or self-contradicting shadow is refused by the receipt check.

flakes.verdict.refuses-malformed-shadow.why: A bad shadow recorded beside a receipt would poison later comparisons.

proves.claim: a recorded proof keeps the real verdict unchanged when the shadow differs.

flakes.verdict.shadow-keeps-real-verdict.why: Tier 1 is report-only evidence and must never change the independent verdict.

proves.claim: native.js names no apps/ path and the committed ceiling holds no row for it.

flakes.native.no-apps-path.why: A package that names an app path breaks the one-way import rule.

proves.claim: one observation is immutable and idempotent; the first files one ordinary repair item and a second joins it.

flakes.ledger.observation-immutable-idem.why: Repeated sightings must not file duplicate repair items.

proves.claim: a landed repair is fixed until the same test is seen again.

flakes.ledger.landed-repair-fixed-until-.why: A fixed flake that reappears must reopen, and one that does not must stay fixed.

proves.claim: flake observations replay exactly and duplicate engine receipts do not add sightings.

flakes.ledger.replays-exactly.why: The ledger is derived from events and must rebuild identically.

proves.claim: old engines, unjoined actors and impossible evidence cannot add observations.

flakes.ledger.refuses-impossible-evidenc.why: Only joined actors on a current engine may add sightings.

proves.claim: three failures in one file produce one candidate probe, one main probe and three recorded outcomes.

flakes.native.one-probe-per-file.why: Probing per case multiplied runner time by the failure count.

proves.claim: without a batch writer each case is still recorded once, after every probe has run.

flakes.native.records-once-without-write.why: Callers without a batch writer must not double-record outcomes.

proves.claim: a batch probe that crashes after some cases ran proves none of them.

flakes.native.crashed-batch-proves-none.why: A partial batch is not evidence for any case.

proves.claim: a history warmed before the lock parses only the events since, inside it.

flakes.history.warm-parses-only-new-even.why: Rereading the whole log inside the board lock made writes slow.

proves.claim: a run read inside a transaction that rolls back is never kept.

flakes.history.rolled-back-run-not-kept.why: A kept rolled-back run would show history that never happened.

proves.claim: a log that no longer matches the kept prefix is read again from the start.

flakes.history.mismatched-prefix-rereads.why: A rewritten log must not be answered from a stale cache.

proves.claim: shared runs are frozen, so one caller cannot change what the next reads.
warming outside a transaction keeps the history; inside one it reads nothing early.

flakes.history.warm-inside-transaction-r.why: Reading early inside a transaction would take the lock the warm-up avoids.

proves.claim: a write from a second connection during the capture neither refuses it nor changes it from a quiet capture.

flakes.ratchet.second-connection-write-h.why: A busy board must never refuse landing because of the ratchet capture.

proves.claim: every flakes-cell test registered here has a stable ID and one complete record, and an unregistered test is reported and fails only with tests.registryStrict on.

flakes.registry.complete.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.

proves.claim: every flakes test file that reads files opens with an input header naming the cells it reads.

flakes.inputs.declared.why: Affected-test selection can only see a reader that declares what it reads.

proves.claim: with the outside-src rule on, the reader rule reports no flakes test file.

flakes.inputs.rule-clean.why: The declared-inputs rule must stay clean in this cell once it is turned on.
